category_title: Struggling readers who use physical activity and gestures to participate
student_description: Luis is an active, kinesthetic learner who participates in literacy activities through physical movement and gestures. He struggles with word recall and encoding, often guessing letters, and is highly sensitive to public failure. He uniquely requires auditory segmenting for spelling correction, discreet whispered prompting to save face during public reading, and opportunities to connect his out-of-school literacy practices to the classroom.

criteria.rationale: Because Luis struggles with word recall and tends to guess letters, breaking words down into auditory sounds helps him encode accurately.
criteria.check: The tutor provides auditory segmenting (e.g., breaking a word into individual phonetic sounds) when the student struggles with spelling or writing a word.

criteria.rationale: Luis needs to maintain his confidence during public reading tasks and can easily lose face if corrected openly or left to struggle.
criteria.check: The tutor uses discreet methods, such as whispered prompting or quiet cues, to supply words when the student struggles during a public or group reading task.
